## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, snippet build, tests, CLI build).
- [ ] A line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md, if a user would notice the change.
- [ ] `--help` and README.md updated, if an option or what it prints changed.
- [ ] A new kind of finding, or a change to one, comes with a test that has the real thing and traps that look like it but aren't (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Adding a kind of finding").
- [ ] Nothing new is sent anywhere: no new address the CLI calls, and nothing more goes to the AI (PRIVACY.md).
